title: Model Performance Kill-Criterion Monitoring Log
description: A continuously-updated observable log comparing a model's actual performance (prediction error, realised loss) against its pre-defined kill criterion, including any breach and the resulting pause.
evidence_description: A record of the model's actual performance against its pre-defined kill-criterion threshold at regular intervals, including the threshold value, actual measured performance, and — if breached — the timestamp and details of the resulting automatic pause.
collection_method: Automated monitoring pipeline comparing live performance metrics to the pre-defined threshold on a recurring schedule.
retention_period: Minimum 5 years, aligned with typical financial model-risk record-keeping expectations.
artifact_format: Structured export (CSV/JSON) of performance-versus-threshold measurements over time.
